The t_chain "failures" are the three known-wrong expectations I analyzed earlier (hop1 vs hop2 wires differ due to trusted_out; the big-body test didn't actually exceed 32768). Let me fix those tests to reflect the correct expected behavior (verified earlier with the compact-header growth test).

Let me update t_chain.py:
1. "hop1 == hop2 wire" → they should differ (hop1 trusted_out=True emits PAI; hop2 trusted_out=False omits it).
2. Replace the big-body growth test with the verified compact-header growth test.

Then run the fuzz test again with the final code, and do a final CLI end-to-end run.

Let me also add a couple of extra chain tests:
- A chain where the source's wire is re-parsed at a local ingress with an unknown subject → unauthenticated.
- Deep chains (e.g., 50 hops) to ensure stability.

Let me update.

cd /workspace/tmp/work && python3 - <<'EOF'
s=open('t_chain.py').read()
s=s.replace('''chk("hop1 == hop2 wire", res[1]["wire"]==res[2]["wire"], True)''',
'''chk("hop1 has PAI, hop2 does not", ("P-Asserted-Identity" in res[1]["wire"], "P-Asserted-Identity" in res[2]["wire"]), (True, False))''')
s=s.replace('''# growth: a request whose normalization grows (long CSeq zeros / big display names) beyond 32768?
big_body = "z"*32000
jobs=[J("edge",L("session-k"),True,raw=req(body=big_body)),J("edge",L("session-k"),True,source=0)]
res=run(jobs)
chk("big body hop0",res[0]["status"],"accept")
chk("big body hop1 len",len(res[0]["wire"])>32768,True)
chk("big body hop1",dec(res[1]),"reject:syntax")''',
'''# growth: compact header names + added Privacy/PAI make the forwarded text longer
def compact(body_len):
    r = req(body="z"*body_len).replace("From:","f:").replace("To:","t:").replace("Call-ID:","i:")
    r = r.replace("Content-Type:","c:").replace("Content-Length:","l:")
    return r
raw = None
for bl in range(32500, 32700):
    cand = compact(bl)
    if len(cand) <= 32768 and len(cand) > 32700:
        raw = cand
        break
chk("compact raw within limit", len(raw) <= 32768, True)
jobs=[J("edge",L("session-k"),True,raw=raw),J("edge",L("session-k"),True,source=0),J("edge",L("session-k"),True,source=1)]
res=run(jobs)
chk("grew hop0 accepted", res[0]["status"], "accept")
chk("grew hop0 wire over limit", len(res[0]["wire"]) > 32768, True)
chk("grew hop1 syntax", dec(res[1]), "reject:syntax")
chk("grew hop2 upstream", dec(res[2]), "reject:upstream")
# deep chain of 40 hops stays stable
jobs=[J("edge",L("session-k"),True,raw=req())]
for i in range(1,40):
    jobs.append(J("edge",L("session-k"),True,source=i-1))
res=run(jobs)
chk("deep chain all accept", all(r["status"]=="accept" for r in res), True)
chk("deep chain stable wire", len({r["wire"] for r in res}), 1)
# source at local ingress with unknown subject
jobs=[J("edge",L("session-k"),True,raw=req()),J("edge",L("ghost"),True,source=0)]
res=run(jobs)
chk("source local unknown subject", dec(res[1]), "reject:unauthenticated")''')
open('t_chain.py','w').write(s)
EOF
cd /workspace/tmp/work && python3 t_chain.py
